findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be set up upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer solution was prepared and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is prepared and available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

(REPEAT) Observed the soda nozzle area to have large accumulation of slime and mold again. The holder for the gun had a thick layer of pink slime and fuzzy mold under the tray and where the tip of the soda gun rests. PIC was instructed to wash, rinse, sanitize the area. Discussion was held about frequently cleaning the entire soda nozzle area (taking off the gun cap, removing the gun tray in the holder). Ensure frequent cleaning and sanitizing to prevent mold build-up. PIC washed, rinsed, and sanitized. COS. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 10/5/21.

Observed the pizza tray pans for both pizza ovens to have a significant amount of pizza debris. PIC was instructed to clean both areas. Ensure staff is cleaning the pizza trays as often as needed to prevent food build-up. Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.11: (A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be safe. P Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be: (B) Durable, nonabsorbent, and CORROSION-RESISTANT (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion. C

Observed the reach-in cooler at the bar (with juice) to have duct tape utilized as the handle to the door. Cease practice. Duct tape is not an approved material. Discussed with PIC. Ensure repairs to this cooler handle before the next routine inspection.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

Observed no food handler’s licenses for all the employees. All employees handle ice and have the ability to make frozen pizzas. Ensure all employees obtain a food handler’s license within 30 days of employment. Keep copies at the facility. License valid for 3 years. Discussed with PIC. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The nozzle of the soda gun is observed with a thick accumulation of mold/slime. Discussed with the PIC. It is currently being soaked in bleach once a week. This is obviously not sufficient. PIC instructed to clean regularly (wash/rinse/sanitize) to prevent the accumulation of possible contaminants/ pathogens. The item was cleaned during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

Heavy whipping cream in the craft cooler is observed at 48F internal temperature. Cream was discarded and will be stored in the keg cooler (observed at 35F) in the future.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the pizza oven soiled with food debris. Clean the food contact surface.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed some Parmesan cheese that stated on the label to refrigerate after opening was found out at room temperature. Potentially hazardous foods must be refrigerated after opening.
The cheese was discarded during the inspection.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the pizza oven soiled with food debris. Clean the food contact surface.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
Observed waste water in the mop room. Waste water must be dumped after each use. The waste water was dumped during the inspection.
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the soap dispenser in the men's restroom to be broken. Repair the soap dispenser to properly dispense soap.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed the mop stored improperly. Either invert the mop or hang to dry.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
